description: Known vendor key prefixes (OpenAI sk-, AWS AKIA, GitHub ghp_, Slack xox*). A generic high-entropy-string fallback for unrecognized formats is a follow-up, not in this rule.

About text content that mentions a password (e.g. typed into an AI chat), never about inspecting an actual password form field - that's out of scope per CLAUDE.md's privacy principles and is a browser/app concern for later phases. Known false-positive risk: matches any word after 'password is', including non-password words like 'important' - see test-corpus/secrets.jsonl for a documented case that isn't gated by the Phase 1 quality target.
